name: Berlin, Beats & Boats 2026
description: For the 14th edition, Berlin's Spree River transforms into a floating festival stage. Seven excursion boats become dance floors, each curated by different Berlin clubs, labels, and DJ collectives offering a wide spectrum of electronic music from house to techno. Attendees dance both on deck and inside the vessels as they cruise through the city's waterways. After the boats return, the official afterparty continues at WEEKEND Club well into the night. The event combines club culture with Berlin's unique aquatic geography, creating an iconic summer tradition that merges the city's underground music scene with its industrial river landscape.
